results.title: Apple Set to Deliver Slight Earnings Miss for March Quarter
results.author: Emily Jarvie
results.text: Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) is expected to report March-quarter financial results that may come in slightly below consensus expectations, according to Jefferies analysts who maintained a Hold rating.
highlights: Apple Inc is expected to report March-quarter financial results slightly below consensus
Jefferies maintained a Hold rating with price target of $295

results.title: Apple's AI Strategy Is Pivoting
results.author: James Brumley
results.text: After struggling for over a year to develop its own artificial intelligence assistant, Apple seems to be opening up iOS 27.
highlights: Apple opening up iOS 27 to accommodate AI rivals like ChatGPT and Gemini
